learningObjectives: Identify the major components of the Hippocampus.
Explain how the Hippocampus contributes to distributed brain function.
Connect Hippocampus physiology with clinically relevant symptoms and conditions.
Interpret structural or functional findings cautiously and in context.

anatomy.label: Dentate gyrus
anatomy.detail: Sparse coding helps distinguish similar input patterns.
anatomy.clinical: Reduced separation can increase memory interference.

anatomy.label: CA3
anatomy.detail: Recurrent connections support retrieval from partial cues.
anatomy.clinical: Overgeneralised completion can blur distinct contexts.

anatomy.label: CA1
anatomy.detail: CA1 integrates entorhinal input with CA3 predictions.
anatomy.clinical: Sensitive to hypoxia and temporal-lobe epilepsy.

anatomy.label: Subiculum
anatomy.detail: Routes processed information to cortical and subcortical targets.

anatomy.label: Entorhinal cortex
anatomy.detail: Provides major input and output pathways linking hippocampus with association cortex.
anatomy.clinical: Early degeneration affects memory in Alzheimer disease.
